title: Cheapest Days to Fly During the Holidays in 2026
summary: Find the cheapest days to fly for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s in 2026, plus busy travel dates and planning tips.
body_markdown:
A small change to your holiday travel dates could make a meaningful difference in airfare. The busiest departure and return days often cost more, while flying earlier in the week or on the holiday itself may cost less. Here are the cheapest days to fly for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s in 2026, based on current airfare data.
‍


> **Editor’s Note:** Airfares change quickly. The dates and prices below are based on airfare searches and average ticket prices available when the cited reports were published. Check current fares for your route before booking.

## **The Cheapest Days to Fly for Thanksgiving**


Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, in 2026. The common Wednesday departure and Sunday return may fit a long weekend, but that convenience can come at a price.


[Hopper’s 2026 Holiday Travel Index](https://media.hopper.com/research/2026-holiday-travel-index) found Monday, November 23, to be the most affordable Thanksgiving departure dateDomestic round-trip fares averaged about $370, roughly $50 less than Wednesday departures.


Flying on Thanksgiving Day itself was priced similarly, with average round-trip fares around $371. That option works best when you have a short flight, an early departure, or flexible celebration plans.
‍


### **Avoid the Sunday Return Rush**


Sunday, Nov. 29, is the main date to avoid for the trip home. Hopper found domestic round-trip tickets returning that day averaged $604. CLEAR also expects the return rush to peak Sunday, Nov. 29.


Returning Monday, Nov. 30, or Tuesday, Dec. 1, may offer better value. Hopper found average round-trip fares around $350, a difference of as much as $250 per ticket. If extending the trip is not possible, returning on Black Friday was the next-best option in Hopper’s data, with fares averaging about $420.


Returning Monday, November 30, or Tuesday, December 1, brought the average cost down to about $350, a difference of as much as $250 per ticket. If extending the trip is not possible, returning on Black Friday was the next-best option in Hopper’s data, with round-trip fares averaging about $420.


The takeaway is simple: If you can, shift your departure or return by a day. Moving outside the Wednesday-to-Sunday window may help lower your fare.
‍


## **The Cheapest Days to Fly for Christmas**


Christmas falls on Friday, December 25, in 2026. Hopper found that the weekend before the holiday was the most expensive departure period. Flights leaving Friday, December 18, through Sunday, December 20, were averaging just under $500 round trip.


Departing Monday, December 21, or Tuesday, December 22, brought the average closer to $440. That makes the Monday and Tuesday before Christmas the better-value departure options in the current data.


If your schedule allows, compare Christmas Eve and Christmas Day as well. Holiday-day flights can sometimes cost less because fewer travelers want those times, but the best option will depend on your route.


Price and crowd patterns do not always move together. Although Tuesday, December 22, may offer a lower average fare, CLEAR expects larger airport crowds than usual on that day and Wednesday, December 23. Friday, December 18, is expected to be the busiest day for Christmas departures.


If you choose a lower fare on a busy date, leave extra time and check current airport conditions before your trip.


### **Choose Your Return Date Carefully**


Sunday, December 27, is the main date to avoid for the trip home. Hopper found fares for that return date were about 20% higher than flights earlier in the week.


CLEAR also expects the return rush to peak on Sunday, December 27, with crowds beginning to ease around 5 p.m. Across the Christmas travel period, airport security lines are expected to be busiest from 5 to 7 a.m., with smaller crowds later in the day.


Traveling from Monday, December 28, through Wednesday, December 30, may offer better value. For a longer trip, compare fares carefully before Saturday, January 2. Hopper found prices rising above $560 as travelers returned after the holiday break.


These forecasts are based on prior travel patterns and may change. Check your flight, airport conditions, and live security wait times before leaving home.
‍


## **The Cheapest Days to Fly for New Year’s**


New Year’s Day falls on Friday, January 1, in 2027. Current average ticket prices reported by[Travel + Leisure](https://www.travelandleisure.com/cheapest-days-to-fly-for-the-holidays-in-2026-12146377) point to Wednesday, December 30, as the cheapest New Year’s departure date and Friday, January 1, as the cheapest return date.


Saturday, January 2, was the most expensive day in that New Year’s analysis. Hopper also found a price surge around January 2 for travelers returning from longer Christmas trips.


Those dates may not fit every celebration. If you plan to stay through New Year’s Eve, compare January 1 with nearby midweek dates and weigh the fare against the amount of time you want at your destination.
‍


## **Why Midweek Holiday Flights Often Cost Less**


Holiday travel demand is concentrated around a few dates. Many people want to leave after work or school and return before Monday, which pushes more travelers toward weekends and the day before a holiday.


The broader[Google Flights 2026 analysis](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/holiday-travel-trends-2026/) found that departing Monday and returning Tuesday or Wednesday saved an average of 14% compared with weekend travel. For domestic trips, the difference reached 20% compared with departing and returning on Sunday.


That pattern is more useful than waiting for a certain day to buy. Google found only a 1.4% difference between Wednesday, the cheapest booking day, and Sunday, the most expensive. The dates you fly can matter far more than the weekday when you purchase the ticket.
‍


## **How to Find a Better Holiday Fare**


### **Compare a Range of Dates**


Search a few days before and after your preferred itinerary. A flexible-date calendar can show whether leaving one day earlier or returning one day later changes the fare.


Compare the full round trip, not just one flight. A cheaper departure can be offset by an expensive Sunday return.


### **Check Nearby Airports**


If your city or destination has more than one airport, compare them. Include parking, rideshare, rental car and travel time in the total cost.


A lower fare may not save money if the alternate airport adds a long or expensive transfer.


### **Review the Full Ticket Price**


Check baggage fees, seat-selection charges, fare restrictions and change rules before buying. A low base fare may cost more once you add what your trip requires.


If you are deciding between a nonstop and a connection, consider winter weather and the extra chance for disruption. The lower fare is not always the better value.


### **Book the Earliest Flight You Can**


Hopper found flights departing after 9 a.m. were twice as likely to be delayed as flights scheduled between 5 and 8 a.m. An early flight may give you more same-day rebooking options if weather or another disruption affects your trip.


### **Build in Flexibility**


A buffer day can help when your plans depend on arriving before a family gathering or celebration. Review the airline’s change and cancellation policies, turn on flight alerts, and know which other flights serve your destination that day.

## **Choose the Holiday Travel Dates That Work for You**


The cheapest days to fly during the holidays are often the dates other travelers avoid. For Thanksgiving, consider leaving Monday or on the holiday itself and returning Monday or Tuesday. For Christmas, look at a Monday or Tuesday departure and avoid the Sunday return rush.


Price matters, but so do celebration time, work schedules, airport crowds, connections, and the risk of winter disruptions. Compare nearby dates, review the full trip cost, and book the itinerary that makes your journey as seamless as possible.
